current_interpretation: Nonempty DMR_COMMENT_TEXT on permit_limit rows is preserved structurally but not converted into World-true monitoring rules. The permit_limit_comment_text requirement lists only the empty string as known, so all 69 nonempty comments are uninterpreted. Separately, construction.py scans comment text and emits named EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED items: 17 rows containing 'WHEN DISCHARGING' as conditional_discharge_dependent_monitoring, 40 rows containing 'GEOMETRIC MEAN' as aggregated_reporting_requirement, and 12 rows containing both 'PASS = 0' and 'FAIL = 1' as pass_fail_reporting_semantics. The draft does not decide whether discharge occurred, how geometric-mean aggregation applies to individual periods, or how pass/fail reporting maps to numeric comparison.
why_it_matters: Purpose B requires determining whether monitoring was required, not required, or unresolved for FY2025 obligations. Purpose A and C are also affected when comments condition comparison or missing-evidence handling. Comments such as 'WHEN DISCHARGING.' may mean monitoring applies only if discharge occurred, but structured sources in this workspace do not establish discharge occurrence for evaluated periods.
